title: C deaddrop/confessions diverge from spec: budgets, response codes, no by-id/Observe/ACL, confessions stub stores nothing (spec 18.9/18.10)
description: Spec 12-apps.md 18.9/18.10 normative limits and resource contracts diverge in the C/Zephyr stack. Evidence: deaddrop POST returns 2.04 with no Location-Path or Max-Age (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_dtn.c:205), GET has only ?node= filter, no by-id, no Observe (:211-241); budgets MAX_PACKET_SIZE 1280 vs 1536, MAX_BYTES 65536 vs 8/32 KB, cooldown-only rate limit no hourly cap (dtn.h:31-49, coap/Kconfig LICHEN_COAP_DEADDROP_RATE_LIMIT_MS 60000); no 4.13, store failure returns 5.00 not 5.03 storage_full (:163-179); no read privacy ACL. Confessions: confessions_post validates and rate-limits but stores nothing and returns 2.04 (coap_dtn.c:269-317), confessions_get returns one float record (:243-267); C requires OSCORE on confessions POST where spec makes it optional (:287-293); rate key is 256 buckets by last IID byte with no hourly cap (:300-313). Python and Rust conform and are vector-tested (test/vectors/deaddrop.json, confessions.json, confessions_rate.json). Suggested placement: lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_dtn.c + dtn.h + coap/Kconfig. Refs R-12-079, R-12-080, R-12-085, R-12-087 (C), R-12-089, R-12-096.
